import Mathlib

theorem p05 : ¬ ∃ q : ℚ, q * q = 2 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hq' : ((q : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 2 := by
    rw [sq]
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have h : Real.sqrt 2 = |(q : ℝ)| := by
    rw [← hq', Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  have hirr : Irrational (|(q : ℝ)|) := by
    rw [← h]
    exact irrational_sqrt_two
  rw [← Rat.cast_abs] at hirr
  exact hirr ⟨|q|, rfl⟩

Mathlib's irrational_sqrt_two then gives Irrational |(q:ℝ)|; rewriting with Rat.cast_abs makes it Irrational ((|q| : ℚ) : ℝ), contradicting Irrational's definition (x ∉ Set.range Rat.cast) with witness ⟨|q|, rfl⟩.
